points.title: Surya dev ka rath
points.text: Odisha ke Konark mein Raja Narasimhadeva I ne pura mandir rath jaisa banwaya.

points.title: 24 pahiye, 7 ghode
points.text: Pathar ke pahiye itne baarik hain ki inhe dhoop-ghadi bhi maana jata hai.

points.title: Chumbak ka rahasya
points.text: Kahani hai ki shikhar par vishaal chumbak tha. Iska koi pakka saboot nahi mila.

takeaway: Aaj ye UNESCO World Heritage hai, aur 10 rupaye ke note par bhi.
cta: Follow karo, roz ek nayi kahani
